2121346280224174520.en_summary: AMAZON REPORTEDLY REVIVES FERMI DEAL. $FRMI has reached a preliminary agreement for 600MW of power capacity at its Texas data center campus with a hyperscaler identified as Amazon by the FT. The agreement comes nearly a year after Amazon walked away from earlier talks. Amazon is now expected to build its own data centers on the site, with power delivery beginning in 2027. Includes $200M prepayment, $15M for early construction and proposed $90M purchase of building materials. Long-term lease not yet finalized. Source: FT
2121346280224174520.zh_summary: 據報導亞馬遜重啟Fermi交易。$FRMI已與其德克薩斯數據中心園區600MW電力容量達成初步協議，FT確認超大規模客戶為亞馬遜。該協議在亞馬遜退出早期談判近一年後達成。亞馬遜現預計在該地點建造自己的數據中心，電力交付從2027年開始。包括2億美元預付款、1500萬美元早期建設和擬議的9000萬美元建築材料購買。長期租約尚未最終確定。來源：FT

ticker_notes.FRMI: Preliminary 600MW power agreement with Amazon for Texas data center campus, power from 2027.
